main.description: ADR-2604261717 counter-claim against a stakedAttestation. Locks counterBond in ClaimStakeEscrow keyed by the same claimId. If the arbiter rules the claim slashed, the challenger receives counter_bond + bond * 0.85; if upheld, the challenger forfeits counter_bond.

counterBond.description: GCC wei (uint256 decimal string). Per-actor minimum is enforced by the contract
